pregame.pressurePoint: Central Michigan run game vs Ohio run defense. Ohio is No. 69 of 138 against the run (41%). Central Michigan ranks No. 102 in rush success rate (40%). A real edge, not a lock. Central Michigan will find the run hard going. Expect more second-and-long than usual. Watch Central Michigan's yards per carry through the first quarter. Under 3 and the game plan has to change.

edges.why: Ohio is No. 14 of 138 in line yards per carry (3.57). Central Michigan ranks No. 136 at the line of scrimmage (3.53). This is not a lean. It is a mismatch, and a prominent one. The line of scrimmage belongs to Ohio. Second-level runs and play-action are live all afternoon.

Ohio is No. 59 of 138 in rush success rate (46%). Central Michigan ranks No. 132 against the run (50%). A clear edge, the kind that shapes a game plan. Ohio should stay on schedule on the ground, which keeps third downs short and the clock moving.

Central Michigan is No. 17 of 138 at limiting explosive passes (1.33). Ohio ranks No. 69 in pass explosiveness (1.55). A real edge, not a lock. Central Michigan keeps the lid on. Ohio should expect to drive the long way.
